pages.raw_title: Who We Are - CLEAR's Mission & Values | CLEAR
pages.raw_meta: Since day one, we’ve been obsessed with making daily life safer and easier. Learn more about CLEAR, our mission and values, and plans for the future.
raw_blocks: An identity company that powers effortless experiences wherever you go.
Since day one, we’ve been obsessed with making daily life safer and easier for you. With our secure identity platform, all you need is you to move freely through your world.
We’re on a mission to make the journey as joyful as the destination—from airports to arenas, offices, and online.
We help businesses transform their customer experiences to increase trust, efficiency, satisfaction, and loyalty.
We create powerful solutions that move you forward faster—so you can spend more time doing what you love.

We’re looking for indefatigable problem-solvers who embrace change and turn big ideas into bold decisions. If this sounds like you, explore our open roles to find the right fit for your skills and expertise.

Caryn Seidman Becker is the Chair, CEO, and Founder of CLEAR. In 2010, Caryn acquired CLEAR out of bankruptcy and has grown it into a global company with 62 airport locations, hundreds of partners, and more than 43 million verified users nationwide.
